name: ruff-format
description: Rewrites Python with Ruff's safe fixes and formatter once per batch of tool calls and at git pre-commit, only when a Ruff config governs the file, using the consuming repo's own Ruff config; lint findings are reported at commit.

ruff_format_enabled.title: Rewrite Python after edits
ruff_format_enabled.description: After each batch of tool calls, run Ruff check --fix and format over the Python files it wrote

ruff_format_lint_gitignored.title: Act on files git ignores
ruff_format_lint_gitignored.description: By default the hook leaves a file the repository gitignores alone: it is not rewritten or linted, since a rewrite of an ignored file has no git checkout to undo it. Set true to act on gitignored files too. A tracked file that matches an ignore pattern is always in scope.

ruff_format_end_of_turn.title: Check Python in uncommitted changes at turn end
ruff_format_end_of_turn.description: At the end of each turn, run the pre-commit Ruff check over the lines changed since the last commit and hand any findings back so they are fixed before the turn ends, at most once per turn. Nothing is rewritten. Off by default.
